what: IQVIA runs clinical trials for drug companies and sells them data and analytics about prescriptions and markets. It is the largest contract research organisation in the world and also the largest provider of pharmaceutical market data.
customers: Pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies of all sizes, plus medical device makers and healthcare providers.
money: running clinical trials for drug companies
prescription data, market analytics and software
outsourced sales and medical affairs teams
moat: Decades of prescription and claims data that no competitor can assemble, combined with the trial infrastructure that uses it to find patients faster.
risks: Debt of about $16 billion against $2 billion of cash
Biotech funding weakness has reduced small-customer trial bookings
Large pharmaceutical companies have cut research spending
Cancelled trials reduce the backlog that converts into revenue
opportunities: Analysts see about 22% upside from current levels
A multi-year backlog gives revenue visibility
Its data business earns high margins and is hard to replicate
watch: Net new business bookings and the book-to-bill ratio.
